quote: Attachment is The Root of Suffering
author: Buddha

quote: Judge nothing, you will be happy Forgive everything, you will be happier Love everything, you will be happiest
author: Buddha

quote: Let the past make you better, not bitter
author: Buddha

quote: The meaning of life is just to be alive. It is so plain and so obvious and so simple. And yet, everybody rushes around in a great panic as if it were necessary to achieve something beyond themselves.
author: Alan Watts

quote: THE MIND KNOWS NO ANSWERS. THE HEART KNOWS NO QUESTIONS.
author: BUDDHA

quote: This is the real secret of life -- to be completely engaged with what you are doing ... And instead of calling it work, realize it is play
author: Alan Watts
